races.name: Citipost Amateur Jockeys' Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
Despite losing his unbeaten record over fences, LITTLE LEDGEND emerged with plenty of credit when third in a similar amateur riders' handicap over C&D 3 weeks ago. In a change of headgear he's marginally preferred to Herakles Westwood and Transmission, both of whom have previous in this race.

  1. LITTLE LEDGEND (IRE)
  2. HERAKLES WESTWOOD (FR)
  3. TRANSMISSION (IRE)

races.name: JCB Triumph Trial Juvenile Hurdle (Registered As The Prestbury Juvenile Hurdle) (Grade 2) (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
James Owen has won 2 of the last 3 renewals and has a good chance of adding to that tally with CHARLES DARNAY, who looks another very useful juvenile for connections after his listed win at Wetherby. Irish challengers Atomic City and Admiral Will Brown were both impressive when making winning debuts in this sphere so rate as serious threats.

  1. CHARLES DARNAY
  2. ATOMIC CITY (IRE)
  3. ADMIRAL WILL BROWN

races.name: Paddy Power Arkle Challenge Trophy Trial Novices' Chase (Grade 2) (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
An exciting early-season clash. The mightily impressive OLD PARK STAR looks the one to beat if reproducing the pick of his hurdling form, with the potential for even better to come over fences. Kabral Du Mathan's only defeat since joining Dan Skelton came when a blatant non-stayer in the Stayers' Hurdle. He's a most worthy adversary with last month's impressive chasing debut success under his belt.

  1. OLD PARK STAR (IRE)
  2. KABRAL DU MATHAN (FR)
  3. WORKAHEAD (IRE)

races.name: Paddy Power Gold Cup Handicap Chase (Premier Handicap) (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
A typically competitive renewal of the Paddy Power with preference going to BLUEKING D'OROUX, who improved since being fitted with headgear for Paul Nicholls and makes his debut for Dan Skelton over a track and trip that should suit his prominent-racing style. Madara was a revelation when winning the Plate at the Festival and has to be respected after a spin over hurdles, whilst fellow Festival winner Meetmebythesea remains unexposed and can continue to improve in his second season over fences.

  1. BLUEKING D'OROUX (FR)
  2. MADARA (FR)
  3. MEETMEBYTHESEA (IRE)

races.name: From The Horses Mouth Podcast Handicap Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
Preference is for IFIWEREARICHMAN, who has looked in good form over hurdles this season without being seen to best effect. He could be ready to open his account for the campaign racing from 8 lb below his mark over fences, though Ace of Spades isn't taken lightly for the Skeltons with his reappearance run behind him. Rambo T could also be in the mix.

  1. IFIWEREARICHMAN (IRE)
  2. ACE OF SPADES (FR)
  3. RAMBO T (IRE)

races.name: Paddy Power Intermediate Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
MONEYGARROW hardly damaged his stock when eighth in the Albert Bartlett here in March and looks very interesting tackling handicap company for the first time. He gets the nod over Daylatedollarshort, whose Silver Trophy form is proving strong, with Sunny South West, Hillberry Hill and A King Of Magic all lurking on potentially handy marks.

  1. MONEYGARROW (IRE)
  2. DAYLATEDOLLARSHORT (IRE)
  3. SUNNY SOUTH WEST (IRE)

races.name: Karndean Designflooring Mares' Open NH Flat Race (Listed) (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
An excellent renewal of this listed bumper. ELEGANTEMENTE created a fine impression when forging 6 lengths clear of the reopposing She Was The One on her debut at Ballinrobe in August and, with much better to come, is taken to maintain her unbeaten record up in grade. Soleretta must be held in some regard by her yard for Harry Skelton to side with her over Northern Singer, who landed a recent Chepstow bumper in good style. Miss Master and impressive Stratford winner Gypsy Sky are also feared.

  1. ELEGANTEMENTE (FR)
  2. SOLERETTA (IRE)
  3. MISS MASTER

races.name: Boyle Sports Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
LORIKO tasted success 4 times over hurdles for his top yard during the summer, reaching a near-useful level in the process and having shaped much better than the margin of defeat would imply on chase debut 11 days ago, he looks to have been found an excellent opportunity quickly reverting back to smaller obstacles. Irish raider Combs comfortably rates the chief threat with first-time blinkers applied.

  1. LORIKO (FR)
  2. COMBS (IRE)
  3. SOME GOOD MEN GONE (FR)

races.name: Boyle Sports Back Yourself Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
THE KALOOKI KID didn't go on from his return last season, but he reverts to hurdles from 11 lb below his chase mark and has had a breathing operation ahead of his reappearance. Representing a stable amongst the winners, he gets the vote ahead of Jericoacoara, who opened his account for his current yard when last seen in May.

  1. THE KALOOKI KID
  2. JERICOACOARA (FR)
  3. NOPRESENTLIKETIME (IRE)

races.name: Sebden Steel Celebrating 30 Years In Business Novices' Limited Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
SPADESTEP produced a laboured effort at Carlisle when last seen, but he was a winner first time back (over hurdles) last season and this could be the time to catch him, especially with his yard in red-hot form. Le Beau Madrik came off second best in a match race with Florida Dreams just over a fortnight ago and is now much worse off at the weights, but that experience shouldn't have been lost on him and it's reasonable to believe he can reverse the form.

  1. SPADESTEP (IRE)
  2. LE BEAU MADRIK (FR)
  3. FLORIDA DREAMS (IRE)

races.name: Boyle Sports Now Open In Wetherby Introductory' Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
VELVET OUTLAW is pretty hard to oppose after finishing runner-up in a bumper on Rules debut. Yashin may still possess enough ability to chase him home.

  1. VELVET OUTLAW (IRE)
  2. YASHIN (IRE)
  3. RECOBELLA (FR)

races.name: Boyle Sports Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
Likeable veteran TOMMY'S OSCAR looks the most solid option in a tricky race for betting purposes. Palamon is likely to have a say if on a going day, with similar comments applying to 3-time C&D winner Geryville.

  1. TOMMY'S OSCAR (IRE)
  2. PALAMON (IRE)
  3. GERYVILLE (FR)

races.name: Colin Baldwin Memorial Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
Hat-trick-seeking CENTURION'S SISTER could still be ahead of her mark and is taken to defy a rise in grade. Roarin' Success and Filibustering both look solid dangers in a tight handicap.

  1. CENTURION'S SISTER (IRE)
  2. ROARIN' SUCCESS
  3. FILIBUSTERING

races.name: Boyle Sports Conditional Jockeys' Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
SLANEY OPERA has made a positive start for his new trainer, scoring at Uttoxeter in October and beaten only by an improver over C&D last time, so he is taken to resume winning ways. Safe Destination returned to form when third to the selection on his reappearance and is the pick for second, ahead of Camarrate.

  1. SLANEY OPERA (IRE)
  2. SAFE DESTINATION
  3. CAMARRATE (IRE)

meeting_summary.going: Good-good to soft in places on hurdle course

races.name: A1R Services Ltd Mares' Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
This looks between TI'MAMZEL and Jem's Lilly with the former taken to make a winning start over hurdles having impressed in bumpers.

  1. TI'MAMZEL (FR)
  2. JEM'S LILLY (IRE)
  3. MAGIKA BELLA (FR)

races.name: Freight Movement Same Day Novices' Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
With the benefit of an encouraging comeback/chasing debut under her belt, SCAVENGERS REIGN looks the percentage call for the excellent James Owen Team. Le Tiep's Sacre is likely to be a serious threat if ready to roll on first start over fences.

  1. SCAVENGERS REIGN (IRE)
  2. LE TIEP'S SACRE (FR)
  3. ADMIRAL STEWART (IRE)

races.name: Fitzdares Telephone & Text Betting Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
A big field but there should be plenty more to come from KILDINAN PRINCE this season and with the return to 3m in his favour, he has a lot going for him. Tzarmix and Thank You Ma'am look solid rivals, while Doctor on Call may also raise his game on reappearance.

  1. KILDINAN PRINCE (IRE)
  2. TZARMIX (FR)
  3. THANK YOU MA'AM

races.name: Listen Live To Track Radio Mares' Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
INDEPENDENT LADY shaped well on her return when second at Uttoxeter last month, beaten only by a fellow improver, and she can build on that effort to double her tally. The main danger could be Barafundle Bay, who arrives on the back of a breakthrough success over hurdles, ahead of Mavis Pike.

  1. INDEPENDENT LADY (GER)
  2. BARAFUNDLE BAY
  3. MAVIS PIKE

races.name: Join Fitzdares For A Personal Service Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
KING CALIFET went the right way in his 3 starts over fences last season, opening his chasing account at Newbury in March with the runner-up winning both races since. He is open to further progress on his return and is fancied to follow up, with Jet Smart feared most from only 1 lb above his last winning mark. Dangerous Touch completes the shortlist.

  1. KING CALIFET (IRE)
  2. JET SMART (IRE)
  3. DANGEROUS TOUCH (IRE)

races.name: Cutler And Gross Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
Useful Flat performer ANNIVERSARY has made a sound start over hurdles and his opening mark may underestimate him. This does look competitive, though, with Misterdoc and Moves Like Mason heading the dangers.

  1. ANNIVERSARY
  2. MISTERDOC (FR)
  3. MOVES LIKE MASON (IRE)

races.name: Download The Fitzdares App 'Junior' NH Flat Race (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
NEW ADDINGTON BOY makes some appeal on paper for a yard going well at present, so he's put forward as the answer before market clues. Noe Le Dun, Waverley and Folkham are a trio of others to monitor closely in the betting in a race where only one has experience.

  1. NEW ADDINGTON BOY
  2. NOE LE DUN (FR)
  3. WAVERLEY (IRE)

races.name: QuinnBet Conditional Jockeys' Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
SPARTAN TIMES returns from a short break with his yard continuing in excellent order and given there's still scope from his current mark based on his Flat form, he could be the answer. Lunar Orbit and French recruit Zeus Forlonge head the opposition.

  1. SPARTAN TIMES
  2. LUNAR ORBIT (IRE)
  3. ZEUS FORLONGE (FR)

races.name: Somersby Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
Bumper/hurdles winner SPANISH DARLING didn't look out of place when fourth pitched into a Grade 2 on just his second hurdles start at Cheltenham 3 weeks ago, within a length of the lead prior to fluffing his lines at the last. Firmly remaining with his best days ahead of him, he's impossible to oppose returned to much calmer waters. Bumper winner Port Isaac and newcomers Made For Mary and Montevallo may emerge next best.

  1. SPANISH DARLING (FR)
  2. PORT ISAAC
  3. MADE FOR MARY (IRE)

races.name: Carlsberg EBF Mares' 'National Hunt' Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
MALINA ROAD laid down solid foundations in a trio of bumper starts last winter, including success at listed level and with this increase in trip promising to suit now hurdling, she shades preference over Boombox who went agonisingly close to making a successful stable/hurdling debut at Worcester recently. Bumper scorer Kentford Legacy hails from a yard in form and also commands a second look, as does Port And Brandy.

  1. MALINA ROAD (IRE)
  2. BOOMBOX (IRE)
  3. KENTFORD LEGACY

races.name: Karina's 60th Birthday Celebration Novices' Limited Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
CHAMBERS is well treated on his Flat form and having won his latest start in that sphere, he's fancied to make a successful handicap hurdle debut. Arcon didn't immediately improve on his handicap bow but looks capable of making an impact in this sort of company, whilst Prince Phil can improve handicapping.

  1. CHAMBERS (IRE)
  2. ARCON (GER)
  3. PRINCE PHIL

races.name: Eaton Hall Shooting Ground Mares' Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
A trappy mares handicap which can go the way of the experienced IRISH CHORUS, who did well in this sphere last season and was unable to recover from a late blunder on her recent comeback. Lau And Shaz had a positive time of things over hurdles last campaign and should prove at least as good over fences, whilst Lady Tadita should also benefit from her initial experience chasing.

  1. IRISH CHORUS
  2. LAU AND SHAZ (IRE)
  3. LADY TADITA

races.name: Hobgoblin Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
ORDEROFTHEDAY ought to relish this step back up in trip, and he's taken to make it 2 wins from 3 starts over fences. Kahavari will be suited by speed-favouring conditions and just edges Kalhandrion for next best.

  1. ORDEROFTHEDAY (IRE)
  2. KAHAVARI (FR)
  3. KALHANDRION (FR)

races.name: 1664 Biere Open NH Flat Race (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
JIMMY GATZ is well worth another chance to build on his strong debut form having probably found testing conditions against him at Ffos Las when last seen (Flat bred). Bateleur went down fighting on his Rules debut at Sedgefield last month and his excellent attitude is sure to stand him in good stead again, while the selection's stablemate, Hannah's Kitchen, is the pick of the newcomers before market clues.

  1. JIMMY GATZ (FR)
  2. BATELEUR (IRE)
  3. HANNAH'S KITCHEN (IRE)

meeting_summary.going: Hurdle: good to yielding-yielding in places; chase: yielding-good to yielding in places

races.name: Kilberry Pub & Kitchen Maiden Hurdle
races.verdict:
CHARISMATIC KID is the one to beat on bumper form, and he may well make a winning start over hurdles. The main danger looks to be Willie Mullins' The Irish Avatar, who was useful in his own right in bumpers. OutofAfrika, Luxor Love and Confidence Within are others to note.

  1. CHARISMATIC KID (IRE)
  2. THE IRISH AVATAR (IRE)
  3. OUTOFAFRIKA (IRE)

races.name: Lisadell Equine Hospital 110 Series Final Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
A competitive handicap in which the verdict goes to MINERS BRIDGE, who is seeking the 4-timer after a trio of wins over fences. Magic Day is also respected on the back of her encouraging stable debut, whilst Just For One should benefit from this step back up in trip.

  1. MINERS BRIDGE (IRE)
  2. MAGIC DAY (IRE)
  3. JUST FOR ONE (IRE)

races.name: Hotel Park St. Johann In Tirol Austria Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
SOMMESKY looked sure to win when falling at the last at Punchestown last season and, having been given plenty of time to get over that misfortune, is fancied to make amends despite his lengthy absence. Rightfolksplease has returned better than ever since joining his new yard with back-to-back wins in August and looks the main threat, with both Radiator Springs and Arch Empire also capable of being in the mix.

  1. SOMMESKY (IRE)
  2. RIGHTFOLKSPLEASE (IRE)
  3. RADIATOR SPRINGS (IRE)

races.name: BAR 1 Betting 'Download Our App' For Auction Novice Hurdle (Grade 3)
races.verdict:
THINKITDONTJINXIT made an impressive start over hurdles at Galway last month, travelling and jumping well before quickening clear from the home turn, and he is fancied to cope with the step up in grade, with City of Cork feared most after creating a taking impression on his return at Clonmel and hurdling debutant It's Only A Game and recent Gowran scorer The Captain's Word also respected.

  1. THINKITDONTJINXIT (IRE)
  2. CITY OF CORK (IRE)
  3. IT'S ONLY A GAME (FR)

races.name: Railway Bar Lismullen Hurdle (Grade 2)
races.verdict:
SLADE STEEL has not progressed as hoped since his 2024 Supreme success, but his return to hurdles when last seen duly sparked a revival and he is fancied to make a winning reappearance. The Yellow Clay is a smart hurdler with a good course record to his name and is feared most, with Feet of A Dancer also very much respected due to her excellent record when fresh.

  1. SLADE STEEL (IRE)
  2. THE YELLOW CLAY (IRE)
  3. FEET OF A DANCER (FR)

races.name: BAR 1 Betting Fortria Chase (Grade 2)
races.verdict:
ONLY BY NIGHT boasts an excellent record fresh and, while not at the same level as an on-song Majborough, looks worth chancing against that enigmatic but talented rival in a race where any jumping flaw could prove costly. Solness rates best of the rest.

  1. ONLY BY NIGHT (IRE)
  2. MAJBOROUGH (FR)
  3. SOLNESS (FR)

races.name: Jimmy & Sheila Owens Irish EBF Beginners Chase
races.verdict:
This is often a very informative maiden chase and this year's looks no different. MIGHTY PARK was held back by inexperience in the Supreme following his demolition job on his Fairyhouse hurdling debut and looks one to follow over fences this season. He can get his chasing career off to the perfect start, perhaps at the expense of his stablemate Saint Baco, who could well be suited by the drop back in trip on first go over the larger obstacles. Largy Star and Bleu De Vassy also deserve mentions.

  1. MIGHTY PARK (IRE)
  2. SAINT BACO (FR)
  3. LARGY STAR (IRE)

races.name: BAR 1 Betting Best Odds Guaranteed Overnight (Pro/Am) Flat Race
races.verdict:
A bumper that Gordon Elliott has tended to target over the years and the pick of his trio looks to be £310,000 winning pointer UNCLE PAD, who hammered a rival in his point that has since made an encouraging hurdling debut. Kanzler represents the mighty Willie Mullins and is feared most, with his lengthy absence since winning a point of no real concern given his connections. Airforce Marshal beat a subsequent winner under Rules when landing his point and is also respected.

  1. UNCLE PAD (IRE)
  2. KANZLER (FR)
  3. AIRFORCE MARSHAL (IRE)
